entities.name: Manuela Sáenz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manuela Sáenz de Vergara y Aizpuru was an Ecuadorian revolutionary heroine of South America who supported the revolutionary cause by gathering information, distributing leaflets and protesting for women's rights. Manuela received the Order of the Sun, honoring her services in the revolution.
